text.title: 供水与废物处理展台
text.situation:
后墙边的建筑图展示引入清洁水、带走废物的管道。展示通过这些服务解释公共卫生设施，而不是把这个词当成匆匆洗一次手。旁边封闭的图片盒展示放大的细菌图像，搬动盒子的志愿者戴着手套，以免玻璃上留下指印。

萨姆：那张卡上的prevention是什么意思？
讲解员：设法让某件事不发生。这张卡讲搬运展品时预防事故。
萨姆：盒子看起来很重。
讲解员：搬动它很费体力，所以两个人帮忙。
萨姆：那供水卡片上的dehydrated呢？
讲解员：它形容身体失去过多水分的人。旁边的图片展示水对身体为什么重要。

paragraphs.en: By the back wall, a building diagram showed pipes bringing clean water in and taking waste away. The display described sanitation through these services, rather than treating the word as a name for a quick hand wash. A sealed picture case beside it showed enlarged images of bacteria. The volunteer moving the case wore gloves to keep fingerprints off its glass.
paragraphs.zh: 后墙边的建筑图展示引入清洁水、带走废物的管道。展示通过这些服务解释公共卫生设施，而不是把这个词当成匆匆洗一次手。旁边封闭的图片盒展示放大的细菌图像，搬动盒子的志愿者戴着手套，以免玻璃上留下指印。

paragraphs.en:
Sam: What does prevention mean on that card?
Guide: Trying to stop something from happening. This card is about the prevention of accidents when moving exhibits.
Sam: The case looks heavy.
Guide: Moving it was physically demanding, so two people helped.
Sam: And the word dehydrated on the water card?
Guide: It describes someone who has lost too much water from their body. The picture beside it shows why water matters to the body.
